findings.description: Absent tenant-state row cannot be locked by SELECT FOR UPDATE; first-insert ON CONFLICT may wait after lease check. Require explicit post-upsert lease check and rollback on expiry rather than relying on subplan clock evaluation.

In-snapshot capability check does not prove selected tenant RLS context. Wrong app.org_id may leave organizations visible but hide all facts, yielding empty MATCHED under a misconfigured reader factory. Add fail-closed context assertion and wrong-context regression or explicitly narrow supported trusted reader contract.

Finish token guards tenant outcome, but same-owner stale attempt after reader factory delay can still commit global cursor if attempt replaced; clarify global success-only token semantics or fence cursor on active attempt.
health counts only tracked operational rows including inactive/ineligible tenants; unattempted eligible roster is invisible. Must not imply tenant coverage/healthy empty roster.

positive_findings: All eight root kinds independently traversed; dependency roots are not silently dropped through inner joins.
Per-root-kind kernel accounting partitions mismatch ownership; complete approval histories remain atomic.
Dense root pages retain one MVCC transaction and restart on each invocation; scope overflow refuses checkpoint.
Finish uses lease then state locks and token-conditioned update; diagnostics/cursor omit tenant payload.
Migration uses tenant FK, FORCE RLS and no runtime registration or grants.
evidence_boundaries: Mutable owner draft; no exact commit accepted.
